text:
deploy-bot: starting release/2026-03-22/llm-routing-mini. plan: ff llm_route_v2 -> 10% canary (us-east-1, eu-west-1) then ramp to 40% over 30m. will pin version v2.1.4-canary for the group.
ana: copy. i'll watch api p95, error delta, and kube restarts.
ryan: note: v2.1.4-canary had a GC tuning change in perf branch; watch memory churn.
oncall-bot: alerts: #eng-sre subscribed. page if CPU>80% for 5m or restarts>1 per pod in 10m.
deply-bot: queued: `ffctl set llm_route_v2 --pct 10 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --note "canary start"`
qa-bot: running quick smoke suite (rerank+latency). will post summary.
deply-bot: canary at 10% at 1768400030. telemetry: p95 +3ms, error delta +0.04%, no restarts.
ryan: seeing slight heap growth in a subset of pods (us-east-1). not yet restarts.
nana: hold ramp to 25% for 15m while we observe. command: `ffctl ramp --flag llm_route_v2 --to 25 --step 15m --by 15`
ops-runner: ack. will hold `version.pin` until 12m stable. heartbeat every 4m. if HPA scales >1x in <12m we pause.
deply-bot: at 1768400120 autoscaler kicked in us-east-1 -> 2nd replica added; heap trend still rising. recommendation: partial pinback to eu-only at 25% and reduce us-east to 5% to limit blast.
ryan: agree. applying partial pinback.
ops-runner: running: `ffctl set --flag llm_route_v2 --regions eu-west-1 --pct 25` and `ffctl set --flag llm_route_v2 --regions us-east-1 --pct 5`. leaving version.pin=locked in eu-west-1.
deply-bot: partial pinback applied. telemetry after change: us-east CPU down to 62% after cooldown; heap growth rate slowed.
qa-bot: smoke suite pass in eu-west-1; small rerank drift in us-east-1 samples.
oncall-bot: reminder: quiet window at 23:00-05:00 UTC; rollbacks in that window need @sre lead.
nana: creating follow-up INF-4833 with heap profiles and sample request ids. we'll re-run canary after GC tuning rollback.
ops-runner: attaching HPA graphs and kube events to INF-4833. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
